newsitem.title: CHINA: C. bank sees 9 pct growth for China in 1997.
newsitem.headline: C. bank sees 9 pct growth for China in 1997.

text.p: China's economy is expected to grow by nine percent this year, outstripping a target of eight percent growth, central bank vice governor Chen Yuan was quoted on Wednesday as saying.
Benchmark retail price inflation was seen at under six percent, Chen said in an article published in the Financial News.
China's gross domestic product grew by 9.4 percent in the first quarter, compared with growth for all of 1996 of 9.7 percent.

Retail price inflation was a year-on-year 0.8 percent in May and officials have said the figure for 1997 could be 3.0-4.0 percent, down from 6.1 percent last year and well below a target of 6.0 percent.
